value.rationale: The natural full graph automorphism action is not determined by the known sphere ranks. A new all-parameter integral module and its character distinguish orientation-sensitive actions. The geometric orbit quotient has a sharp, non-obvious stable rational Betti formula depending only on the number of distinct part sizes, including large-homology complexes with rationally acyclic quotients. This is a structural topological classification rather than a narrow numerical recomputation.
